dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Very brave, Arabalika, saying things like protect Vana, just like Aradasha.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: But Aranakula thinks, growing happy flowers in the garden, and spreading their songs among the trees, will also protect Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Aranakula, not half as powerful as Arabalika. But, Aranakula works to be better than half of half of Arabalika.
